scientific_simplifications: Schematic, not molecular structure or scale. One local fork, no chromosome-end/telomerase claim.
Primase/Pol alpha label abstracts RNA initiation and short DNA handoff; individual RNaseH/FEN1 steps omitted.
Show one local primer maturation only; other orange primers remain, final caption must not claim all replication completed.
Parent fork is camera-fixed; synthesis stays on its opened left side. Pol epsilon is the common undisturbed leading-strand teaching model, not an absolute exclusion of Pol delta.
Direction constraint is derived from verified5to3/antiparallel facts plus displayed template endpoints, not a universal sign of x.
Helicase is a generic hexagonal schematic, not a primase SVG or claim about protein structure.
Primer 3prime is covalently extended: after DNA is added, the growing DNA 3prime is free and moves away from the original RNA primer; it need not remain next to the original primer.
Section2 covers origins/licensing. Section4 demonstrates one local fork and one local primer removal; other primers remain.
RNA primer footprints and DNA replacement occupy the same local gap. Centers are derived from paths, not independent coordinates.
The nick is an unsealed covalent bond at two coincident 3prime/5prime endpoints, not a missing nucleotide-sized interval. Ligase sits at this endpoint; removal/fill and sealing are separate events.
Helicase is a generic hexagonal schematic, not a primase SVG or claim about protein structure.
Primer 3prime is covalently extended: after DNA is added, the growing DNA 3prime is free and moves away from the original RNA primer; it need not remain next to the original primer.
